metadata.title: Supra Interact | The Ultimate Smart Contract Interactor
metadata.description: Professional smart contract interactor, testing environment, and interaction suite built specifically for the Supra ecosystem. Connect your wallet, explore modules, and execute transactions seamlessly on Testnet and Mainnet.
metadata.keywords: Supra, Blockchain, Smart Contracts, Explorer, DApp, SupraOracles, Move Language, Web3, Hoglet DAO

Governance.title: Governance & Decentralization
Governance.subtitle: Deploy modules without a private key, donate an existing EOA to a DAO, and renounce governance with cryptographic proof.
Governance.factoryNotPublished: The governance factory is not published yet. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_GOVERNANCE_FACTORY to your deployed module address.
Governance.connectWallet: Connect a wallet to audit your own address
Governance.statusHint: Derived from on-chain cryptographic facts, never from a self-declared flag.
Governance.predictSubtitle: Preview the addresses before deploying or donating.
Governance.actionsSubtitle: Each entry opens the Interactor with the factory module loaded.
Governance.actionDeploy: Deploy a new module into a keyless Resource Account.
Governance.actionDonate: Donate an existing EOA to a DAO through a revocable proxy.
Governance.actionUpgrade: Publish a new version of a governed module.
Governance.actionRenounce: Renounce and destroy the signer capability for good.
Governance.actionDeepFreeze: Publish the final bytecode and revoke the self-offer.
Governance.emptyHint: Paste a contract or EOA address to read its real control state: whether a private key still exists, who holds the admin role, and whether the code can ever be changed again.
Governance.hazardDetail: The private key behind this address is still alive, so the original deployer can bypass the DAO: sign transactions directly or revoke the delegated capability. Do not treat this module as decentralized until the key is destroyed.
Governance.actionTransfer: Hand the admin role to a different address.
Governance.burnBody: This is the call that makes renouncement real. It overwrites the authentication key of this address with 32 zero bytes. Afterwards nobody can sign for it again — including you, and including the original deployer.
Governance.burnAssetWarning: Every coin, fungible asset and NFT still sitting in this address becomes permanently unspendable. Sweep the account before continuing.
Governance.burnGateSwept: I have moved every asset out of this address.
Governance.burnGateUnderstood: I understand the private key will be destroyed permanently and cannot be recovered.
Governance.burnDoneHint: The authentication key is now zero. Re-run the audit to see the new state: the address is either permanently renounced or DAO-governed with no way back.
Governance.burnFailed: Could not submit the key rotation
Governance.actionBurn: Burn your key: rotate this address to ZERO_AUTH_KEY, the step that makes renouncement real.
Governance.runnerConnectWallet: Connect a wallet to run the lifecycle on your own address.
Governance.runnerUnmanagedBody: This address has no factory record yet. Deploy a keyless module, or donate an existing EOA so a DAO can govern it.
Governance.runnerDualMasterBody: Your key is still alive, so you can still bypass the admin. Burn it below to make the delegation final.
Governance.runnerGovernedBody: The key is gone and a DAO holds the admin role. Upgrades, handovers and the final freeze are available.
Governance.runnerFrozenBody: This address is permanently immutable. No signer, capability or offer remains, so nothing can ever change it again.
Governance.deployFormHint: Creates a Resource Account with no private key and binds it to a DAO admin.
Governance.fieldDaoAdminHint: The address that will govern the module. Must not be this wallet, or governance ends up bricked.
Governance.fieldNewAdminHint: Hand the admin role to a DAO, timelock or multisig.
Governance.transferFormHint: One atomic step. There is no two-step confirmation, so a typo here is unrecoverable.
Governance.transferFormWarning: If the new admin is wrong or unreachable, nobody can ever govern this module again.
Governance.deepFreezeFormHint: Publishes the last bytecode on {address} and then destroys every signer.
Governance.deepFreezeFormWarning: The version you upload here becomes permanent. After this the module can never be upgraded again.
Governance.deepFreezeFormAck: I understand this bytecode is final and can never be replaced.
Governance.renounceFormHint: Destroys the signer capability of {address} for good.
Governance.renounceFormWarning: The stored capability is destroyed and the delegated offer is revoked. This cannot be undone by anyone, including a future version of the factory.
Governance.donateFormTitle: Donate this EOA to a DAO
Governance.donateFormHint: One transaction. The factory itself calls the framework's public `offer_signer_capability` for you — all it needs from you is the delegation proof that only your private key can produce.
Governance.donateSignHint: Reads the sequence number this transaction will consume and signs the signed-message payload the framework verifies.
Governance.donateSubmitHint: Registers the delegation with the factory so a DAO can govern this address.
Governance.donateProofNote: Signature only. No gas, no transaction. Submit sends the single donation transaction that carries it.
Governance.burnFrameworkOnly: The factory cannot do this for you. `rotate_authentication_key_call` is declared `entry` (not `public`) in the framework, so Move forbids calling it from any other module — only the key owner can send it directly. Every other step in this lifecycle is orchestrated by the contract, because the functions it needs are public.
Governance.burnOwnerOnly: Only the owner can burn this key, so connect the wallet for this address to continue.
Governance.selfRenounceBody: Burn the key with no DAO in the loop. That is the self-renounce path: the address becomes permanently immutable, with no factory record and nobody able to act for it. Be aware it forecloses the DAO route — once the key is gone you can no longer delegate.
Governance.cancelDelegationBody: Undoes the donation: it revokes the capability you offered to the proxy and drops the factory record, leaving this EOA free to be donated again. Use it if you picked the wrong DAO admin or donated from the wrong wallet.
Governance.cancelDelegationWindow: Only possible while your key is alive. What makes this work is the very hazard the burn removes — once the key is destroyed the delegation is final and only the DAO can renounce.
Governance.cancelDelegationOwnerOnly: Only the owner of this key can cancel its delegation, so connect the wallet for this address to continue.
Governance.cancelDelegationDoneHint: Both offers are revoked and the factory record is gone. This EOA can be donated again whenever you want.
Governance.burnPreviewNote: The audited address is not your connected wallet, so this is a read-only preview of the burn panel. Connect that wallet to make it live.
Governance.burnConnectHint: The wallet you connect must own the audited address — the burn is signed by that key and by nothing else.
Governance.burnGatesHint: Tick both acknowledgements above to continue.
Governance.burnAuditWalletHint: Switches the audit to your connected wallet, so this panel becomes live and the burn can be signed by it.
Governance.burnReauditHint: Re-reads the chain so the new stage shows. Nothing is sent.
